clue.text: Censure the fool for entering a disreputable place

indicators.note: entering means the fool-and-for pieces go inside the word for a disreputable place

parts.note: a dive is a seedy bar or club
a sap is a gullible person
pro means in favour of

explanation.surface: Someone is told off for letting a fool into a low dive.
explanation.definitionFit: To condemn or criticise is to show disfavour, a synonym.

clue.text: Many refuse to speed

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a crossword sign for many
ash is waste left from a fire

explanation.surface: Lots of people decline to drive fast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refuse' looks like a verb but is the noun, waste.
explanation.definitionFit: To race or hurry is to move with speed, a synonym used as a verb.

clue.text: Check arranged, so went all to pieces

indicators.note: going to pieces means the letters of the phrase fall apart and are rebuilt

explanation.surface: A carefully arranged chess check made someone fall apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' belongs to the surface; the rearrangement is signalled by 'to pieces'.
explanation.definitionFit: To block or obstruct, as a batsman or politician does by stalling, is to hold in check.

clue.text: Accommodated, however one regards it

indicators.note: whichever way you look at the letters, forwards or backwards, they read the same

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone was housed, whatever view you take of it.
explanation.definitionFit: To lodge a guest for the night is a phrasal synonym for accommodating them.

clue.text: Regret about unvarying income

indicators.note: about means the regret word wraps round the unvarying word

parts.note: to rue is to regret
even means steady or uniform

explanation.surface: Someone laments having a flat, unchanging salary.
explanation.definitionFit: Money a government or business takes in is its revenue, a synonym.

clue.text: Transport and then ditch a painter

parts.note: a van is a vehicle for carrying goods
a dyke is a drainage ditch

explanation.surface: Someone takes a vehicle and then abandons a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: Van Dyck, the Flemish portrait painter, is anglicised as Vandyke.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony van Dyck was a 17th-century Flemish portraitist working in England.

clue.text: Notice a blemish

explanation.surface: Someone sees a mark on the skin.
explanation.definitionFit: To see something is to spot it; a pimple or stain is also a spot.

clue.text: An instrument to be played quietly

explanation.surface: An instrument that should be played softly.
explanation.definitionFit: The keyboard is the instrument; in music the Italian marking means soft.

clue.text: He may well expect to face entrance charges

definitions.text: He may well expect to face entrance charges

parts.words: He may well expect to face entrance charges
parts.note: reads like someone paying admission fees, but means a person prosecuted for entering land unlawfully

explanation.surface: Someone expects to pay to get in somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: An intruder on private property may be charged for getting in without permission.

clue.text: Film about trade not properly shared out

indicators.note: about means the film word goes round the trade word

parts.note: a mist is a thin film of moisture
a deal is a trade or transaction

explanation.surface: A film about commerce whose profits were unfairly distributed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Film' suggests cinema but means a thin layer, MIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Cards dealt wrongly are distributed improperly, the verb in past tense.

clue.text: Porter of above-average weight

explanation.surface: A heavily built porter.
explanation.definitionFit: Porter and the strong dark beer are related brews; plump people are also described as stout.

clue.text: Few show support

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, a small number
to indicate is to show

explanation.surface: A small group demonstrates its backing.
explanation.definitionFit: To justify or uphold a claim is to support it.

clue.text: Armaments any power may provide

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase can provide the answer once rearranged

explanation.surface: Weapons that any nation might supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Arms and munitions taken together are weaponry, a synonym.

clue.text: Grow faint, so get a medico round before work

parts.note: Dr is the abbreviation for doctor
O is round in shape
op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Someone feeling faint is told to have a doctor visit before going to work.
explanation.definitionFit: To flag or wilt is to sag, losing strength.

clue.text: The look a copper managed in absence of conflict

parts.note: P stands for a penny, a copper coin

indicators.note: in means the managed word sits inside the word for absence of conflict

parts.note: peace is a state free from war
ran means managed, as one runs a business

explanation.surface: A policeman's expression, achieved without any fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: One's outward aspect or how one seems is a synonym for the look.

clue.text: Plainer form of confectionery

indicators.note: a form of the word means its letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A simpler kind of sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: Nut-and-sugar sweets are an example of confectionery.

clue.text: Getting a badly-behaved youngster to the brink is first

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child
a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: Getting a naughty child to the edge of a cliff comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin adverb meaning in the first place is used in English lists.

clue.text: The scholar's mathematical problems are to be returned

indicators.note: returned means the two pieces are read backwards together

parts.note: sums are arithmetic problems

explanation.surface: A scholar's arithmetic exercises must be handed back.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'The scholar', with the 's standing for 'is'. 'to be returned' reads the pair of words backwards as a single run.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dutch humanist of Rotterdam was a famous Renaissance scholar.

clue.text: A woman with backbone in some agency

indicators.note: in means the backbone word goes inside the woman's name

parts.note: Mary is a woman's name
a chine is a backbone or spine, especially of meat

explanation.surface: A determined woman working for some organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: Machinery can mean the means or system by which something is done, a sense of agency.

clue.text: Direction to strike — direction which is obscure

parts.note: E is east
to clip is to hit sharply
SE is south-east

explanation.surface: An order to hit something, then another unclear instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: To overshadow or block out light is to hide, a verb sense.

clue.text: Cost met out of cash, as stated

indicators.note: as stated means the phrase is pronounced, giving a word spelt differently

parts.note: ex means out of and pence is cash, giving a phrase pronounced like the answer

explanation.surface: The bill was paid in cash, as declared.
explanation.walkthrough: 'met' is a link in the surface: the cost is met.
explanation.definitionFit: Money spent on something is its price or charge.

clue.text: The a possibly

parts.note: the words 'the' and 'a' are both examples of a grammatical word class

explanation.surface: A deliberately puzzling bare phrase about words.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, determiners like the and a are definite and indefinite ones.

clue.text: A manual worker having to take a train's quite wrong

indicators.note: the letters are placed wrongly and must be put in the right order

parts.note: the possessive 's adds no letter

explanation.surface: A labourer catching the wrong train.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled craftsman who works with the hands is an artisan.

clue.text: Minister a little beast cut short

indicators.note: cutting short means the last letter is removed

parts.note: a rabbit is a small animal

explanation.surface: A clergyman shortens a small creature's tail.
explanation.definitionFit: A Jewish religious teacher is a minister of a congregation.

clue.text: The dog snapped at small children

parts.note: bit means snapped at with the teeth
ch is the abbreviation for children

explanation.surface: A dog snapped at some young children.
explanation.definitionFit: A female dog is called by this word.

clue.text: Finding a way to call back that's quite touching

parts.note: a path is a way

indicators.note: back means the call word is turned round

parts.note: to cite is to call or summon

explanation.surface: Finding a route to phone again is very moving.
explanation.definitionFit: Something arousing pity is moving, the older sense of the word.

clue.text: Mad gerda, a character in king Lear

indicators.note: mad means the letters of the name are scrambled

explanation.surface: Gerda went mad, like someone in Shakespeare.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloucester's legitimate son is a figure in Shakespeare's tragedy.

clue.text: Sound water supply

explanation.surface: A reliable water source.
explanation.definitionFit: Healthy or fine is a sense of sound; a shaft sunk to reach water is the second.

clue.text: Foodstuffs prepared in turn set out

indicators.note: prepared means the letters are made ready in a new order

explanation.surface: Food set out in turn after being prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: Substances giving nourishment are foodstuffs in a broad sense.

clue.text: Put in note about live bird

parts.note: G is a musical note
re means about or concerning
to be is to exist or live

explanation.surface: Insert a remark about a living bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A diving waterbird is an example of a bird.

clue.text: Repeat some of the Chopin preludes

indicators.note: some of means only part of the letters is used

explanation.surface: Play again parts of the composer's preludes.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound reflected back is a repetition.

clue.text: Mint coinage bearing the queen's head?

parts.note: a penny is a coin
a coin with the monarch's head on it is fittingly royal

explanation.surface: Newly minted money with the monarch's portrait.
explanation.definitionFit: This small aromatic herb is a species of mint.
